sections.html: Vallisneria is an undemanding plant that can transform an aquarium into a lush jungle. It grows quickly and takes up a lot of nitrates. It is cheap and frequently found at fish stores for less than $10.

There are only two requirements to grow vallisneria:

  • Feed it. Easy Green all-in-one fertilizer is recommended, but other fertilizers or heavy fish loads can work as well.
  • Provide it with light using a high quality LED light designed for planted aquariums.

Simply plant one bunch in the back corner of the tank. It will continue to spread throughout the gravel. After a few months, the tank will become a lush jungle with fish weaving in and out of the long leaves. It is easy to remove if it spreads somewhere you don't want it: just pull it out of the gravel and replant it where you want it.

Vallisneria also does well in African cichlid setups, and it can even be used to create a Lake Tanganyika biotope. It grows so fast that it often goes to compost. If you have multiple high-tech planted aquariums, a vallisneria jungle is a nice reprieve from the maintenance.
